notes.title: Update 1.1!
notes.content:
Hey friends!

This update should fix the video crash issue that some players were experiencing, as well as a bunch of bugs that were reported by you guys. Thanks! 

Also, we saw the comments about wanting to play fullscreen! Although there is no menu option, it IS supported. On Windows use [b]Alt+Enter[/b] to switch between windowed and fullscreen! On Mac it should be [b]Command+Control+F.[/b] (This will work with most games as well!)

Thanks again!
